chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever exceeds the prescribed limits in his wudu (ablution) is like one who nullifies it."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.تَعَدَّى: to go beyond the proper limit or exceed what is prescribed
key_terms.نَاقِضِهِ: that which nullifies it or breaks its validity
key_terms.وُضُوئِهِ: his wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about exceeding the limits in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that going beyond the legislated limits in wudu (ablution) is blameworthy and treated like invalidating it. It emphasizes adherence to the prescribed manner of ritual purity in acts of worship.
